instruction: Set all emails in the Bills folder to read status.

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) = (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13)) and (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) > 0;

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all 2 emails in Bills folder (folderID=13) as read. Evaluator verifies that the count of read emails (attributeID=59, value=1) equals the total count of emails in folder 13, ensuring ALL emails are marked as read. Verified with database query: folder 13 contains 2 emails. Uses existing run_sqlite3 metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query logic is correct: compares total email count in folder 13 against count of read emails (attributeID=59, value=1), ensuring ALL emails are marked as read
Query correctly verifies both conditions: (1) all emails are read (total count = read count) AND (2) folder is not empty (count > 0)
Getter get_vm_file correctly extracts Thunderbird SQLite database from VM
Metric run_sqlite3 correctly executes SQL query and returns boolean result (1 or 0)
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird before checking database to ensure writes are flushed
Verification approach is robust and database-level, avoiding UI state dependencies

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
